runs.mode: scan with one code.filesystem connector on the checkout, defaults, use_git false
runs.agentic_rule: a finding of kind agent, agent-config, bot-app, mcp-server, workflow (the tool's own agent kinds)

runs.mode: analyze <checkout> --output-format json; the required LLM endpoint is unreachable offline, so the LLM tier keeps its deterministic candidates (marked unreviewed)
runs.agentic_rule: a component of type agent, agent_proxy, mcp_client, mcp_server, skill, tool
an inventoried agent or an MCP server in the audit

runs.mode: ai discover --scope project -D <checkout> --report-json, then code scan --app <checkout> --db
runs.agentic_rule: an ai-discover item of kind MCP server, coding agent, project configuration or skill, or a code signature tagged agent, mcp or crewai
an inventory item of kind agent, instruction_file, mcp_client_config, mcp_server, skill, subagent
a component or service with cdx:agent:* or cdx:mcp:* properties

runs.mode: case-insensitive ripgrep over every file except .git for provider and framework names
runs.agentic_rule: a file matches the agent-framework or MCP name list

runs.mode: parse dependency manifests (outside vendored dirs) for a fixed list of generative-AI packages
runs.agentic_rule: a dependency on an agent framework or MCP package

runs.mode: scan <checkout> --no-scan --offline -f json (inventory only, no vulnerability lookups), empty HOME
runs.agentic_rule: a framework agent, an agent_framework component, a tool definition, an MCP server, or a discovered agent other than the project wrapper (Terraform agents only with AI resources)
